**3 — Items:** Bun, cooked beef, melted cheese, pickle slices, lettuce, and creamy sauce. No separate oil is clearly visible.

**4 — Area:** The burger covers approximately **22%** of the plate. Non-overlapping visible shares: bun 16%, beef 3%, cheese 0.7%, pickle 1.5%, lettuce 0.5%, sauce 0.3%. **Total: 22%.**

**5–7 — Volume, weight, and energy:** Because this is a stack, visible-area shares conceal parts of the same ingredients.
